description: Score how ready a website is for AI agents and LLM-driven discovery, 0-100 with a letter grade: robots.txt presence, explicit AI-crawler policy (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, and 8 more), llms.txt presence and structure, structured data (JSON-LD) and Open Graph basics, agent/payment discovery files (/.well-known/x402, /openapi.json), sitemap presence, and title/meta basics. The bundle to run before/after making a site agent-friendly — for raw robots/sitemap contents only, use check_robots_sitemap; for classic search SEO only, use seo_audit.

url.description: Any URL on the site to audit (origin is derived from it)

name: ai_readiness_audit
